newsitem.title: UK: Carlton buys Rank film distributors.
newsitem.headline: Carlton buys Rank film distributors.

text.p: Carlton Communications Plc said on Wednesday it had bought the film distribution subsidiary of Rank Group Plc for 65 million stg.

Michael Green, chairman of Carlton Communications, said in a statement, "By adding RFD's prestigious collection of British and international films to our library we will enhance our position as a leading content supplier to the growing number of television channels around the world."
Rank said in a separate statement that proceeds from the sale of Rank Film Distribution would be used to reduce Rank Group's existing debt.

"Following today's sale of RFD, our film and entertainment services division is now clearly focused on serving the film industry, primarily the major Hollywood studios," said chief executive Andrew Teare.
"RFD is the last significant disposal in the programme we announced last August," he added.
Since that date the group has sold 11 businesses and raised around 300 million stg in the process.
RFD distributes and invests in new films and licenses films from its library.
RFD's turnover for the year to December 31, 1996, was 25.4 million stg with operating profit of 4.1 million. Net assets at that time stood at 31.3 million.
